root_cause.text: In `drivers/pinctrl/pinctrl-single.c`’s `pcs_add_gpio_func()`, the `device_node` returned in `gpiospec.np` by `of_parse_phandle_with_args()` was not released with `of_node_put()`, so each loop iteration leaked a reference count on the parsed phandle node.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `of_node_put(gpiospec.np);` both after successfully using the parsed GPIO phandle and on the `devm_kzalloc()` failure path, and the commit message explicitly says `of_parse_phandle_with_args()` increments `gpiospec.np`’s refcount and “the loop iterates through all phandles but never releases the reference.”

intent_record.how: This ensures the device tree node reference held in `gpiospec.np` is released when allocation fails, preventing a reference leak on this failure path.

intent_record.how: This releases the device tree node reference held in gpiospec.np after it is no longer needed, preventing a reference leak during GPIO function registration.
